chiesa-madre-santa-maria-itria.name: Mother Church of Santa Maria d'Itria
chiesa-madre-santa-maria-itria.short_description: Niscemi's Mother Church, the main place of worship in the historic centre.
chiesa-madre-santa-maria-itria.description: The Mother Church, dedicated to Santa Maria d'Itria, is the religious heart of Niscemi's historic centre. It houses works of sacred art and is a landmark for the community.
chiesa-madre-santa-maria-itria.address: Piazza Vittorio Emanuele, Niscemi, CL, Italy

media/images/flat/chiesa-madre-santa-mar.title: Façade of the Mother Church
media/images/flat/chiesa-madre-santa-mar.alt: Exterior view of the Mother Church of Santa Maria d'Itria

media/images/360/chiesa-madre-navata.web.title: Central nave
media/images/360/chiesa-madre-navata.web.alt: 360° panoramic view of the central nave

history.title: Foundation
history.description: The church was built as the main place of worship of the town.

santuario-madonna-del-bosco.name: Sanctuary of the Madonna del Bosco
santuario-madonna-del-bosco.short_description: Sanctuary dedicated to Niscemi's patron saint, set in the cork oak forest.
santuario-madonna-del-bosco.description: The Sanctuary of the Madonna del Bosco is Niscemi's main place of devotion, linked to the patron saint Maria Santissima del Bosco. It stands on the edge of the Sughereta Nature Reserve and is a pilgrimage destination.

media/images/flat/santuario-madonna-del-.title: Sanctuary of the Madonna del Bosco
media/images/flat/santuario-madonna-del-.alt: Sanctuary of the Madonna del Bosco in Niscemi

history.title: Marian devotion
history.description: The sanctuary became the centre of the cult of the town's patron saint.

piazza-vittorio-emanuele.name: Piazza Vittorio Emanuele
piazza-vittorio-emanuele.short_description: Main square of the historic centre, Niscemi's open-air living room.
piazza-vittorio-emanuele.description: The heart of town life, Piazza Vittorio Emanuele opens in front of the Mother Church and is the main meeting point of the historic centre, hosting festivals and events.
piazza-vittorio-emanuele.address: Piazza Vittorio Emanuele, Niscemi, CL, Italy

media/images/360/piazza-vittorio-emanuel.title: Panorama of the square
media/images/360/piazza-vittorio-emanuel.alt: 360° panoramic view of Piazza Vittorio Emanuele

palazzo-comunale.name: Town Hall
palazzo-comunale.short_description: Seat of the municipality, the administrative centre of the town.
palazzo-comunale.description: The Town Hall houses Niscemi's administrative offices and overlooks the main square of the centre.
palazzo-comunale.address: Piazza del Municipio, Niscemi, CL, Italy

history.title: Municipal seat
history.description: The building was adapted to house the local government.
